arxiv-2104-04687.title: Learning from 2D: Contrastive Pixel-to-Point Knowledge Transfer for 3D Pretraining
arxiv-2104-04687.creator: Yueh-Cheng Liu, Yu-Kai Huang, Hung-Yueh Chiang, Hung-Ting Su, Zhe-Yu Liu, Chin-Tang Chen, Ching-Yu Tseng, Winston H. Hsu
arxiv-2104-04687.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yueh-Cheng Liu, Yu-Kai Huang, Hung-Yueh Chiang, Hung-Ting Su, Zhe-Yu Liu, Chin-Tang Chen, Ching-Yu Tseng, Winston H. Hsu. Most 3D neural networks are trained from scratch owing to the lack of large-scale labeled 3D datasets. In this paper, we present a novel 3D pretraining method by leveraging 2D networks learned from rich 2D datasets. We propose the contrastive pixel-to-point knowledge transfer to effectively utilize the 2D information by mapping the pixel-level and point-level features into the same embedding space.

arxiv-2210-16143.title: Overlap reduction functions for a polarized stochastic gravitational-wave background in the Einstein Telescope-Cosmic Explorer and the LISA-Taiji networks
arxiv-2210-16143.creator: Guo-Chin Liu 1 and Kin-Wang Ng 2,3
arxiv-2210-16143.description: Abstract The detection of gravitational waves from the coalescences of binary compact stars by current interferometry experiments has opened up a new era of gravitational-wave astrophysics and cosmology. The search for a stochastic gravitational-wave background is underway by correlating signals from a pair of detectors in the detector network formed by the LIGO, Virgo, and KAGRA.

arxiv-2301-07771.title: Cosmic metal invaders: Intergalactic O VII as a tracer of the warm-hot intergalactic medium within cosmic filaments in the EAGLE simulation
arxiv-2301-07771.creator: T. Tuominen, J. Nevalainen, P. Heinämäki, E. Tempel, N. Wijers, M. Bonamente, M.A. Aragon-Calvo, A. Finoguenov
arxiv-2301-07771.description: Abstract Context. The current observational status of the hot ( log ⁡ T ⁡ ( K ) > 5.5 \log T(K)>5.5 ) intergalactic medium (IGM) remains incomplete. While recent X-ray emission and Sunyaev-Zeldovich effect observations from stacking large numbers of Cosmic Web filaments have yielded statistically significant detections of this phase, direct statistically significant measurements of single objects remain scarce.

arxiv-2305-17204.title: Ropelength and writhe quantization of 12-crossing knots
arxiv-2305-17204.creator: Alexander R. Klotz, Caleb J. Anderson
arxiv-2305-17204.description: Abstract The ropelength of a knot is the minimum length required to tie it. Computational upper bounds have previously been computed for every prime knot with up to 11 crossings. Here, we present ropelength measurements for the 2176 knots with 12 crossings, of which 1288 are alternating and 888 are non-alternating.

arxiv-2405-10992.title: Overcoming Catastrophic Forgetting by Exemplar Selection in Task-oriented Dialogue System
arxiv-2405-10992.creator: Chen Chen, Ruizhe Li, Yuchen Hu, Yuanyuan Chen, Chengwei Qin, Qiang Zhang
arxiv-2405-10992.description: Abstract Intelligent task-oriented dialogue systems (ToDs) are expected to continuously acquire new knowledge, also known as Continual Learning (CL), which is crucial to fit ever-changing user needs. However, catastrophic forgetting dramatically degrades the model performance in face of a long streamed curriculum.

arxiv-2407-15214.title: Physical Encoding Improves OOD Performance in Deep Learning materials property prediction
arxiv-2407-15214.creator: Nihang Fu, Sadman Sadeed Omee, Jianjun Hu
arxiv-2407-15214.description: Abstract Deep learning (DL) models have been widely used in materials property prediction with great success, especially for properties with large datasets. However, the out-of-distribution (OOD) performance of such models are questionable, especially when the training set is not large enough.

arxiv-2503-14111.title: Towards properties of adversarial image perturbations
arxiv-2503-14111.creator: Egor Kuznetsov 1 , Kirill Aistov 1 , Maxim Koroteev 1
arxiv-2503-14111.description: Abstract Using stochastic gradient approach we study the properties of adversarial perturbations resulting in noticeable growth of VMAF image quality metric. The structure of the perturbations is investigated depending on the acceptable PSNR values and based on the Fourier power spectrum computations for the perturbations.

arxiv-2506-08032.title: Tram Positioning with Map-Enabled GNSS Data Reconciliation* (preprint)
arxiv-2506-08032.creator: Jakub Kašpar, Vít Fanta, Vladimír Havlena
arxiv-2506-08032.description: Abstract This paper presents an approach to tackle the problem of tram localization through utilizing a custom processing of Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) observables and the track map. The method is motivated by suboptimal performance in dense urban environments where the direct line of sight to GNSS satellites is often obscured which leads to multipath propagation of GNSS signals.

arxiv-2602-18881.title: Turbo Coded Single Sideband OFDM-OQAM Signaling through Frequency Selective Rayleigh Fading Channels
arxiv-2602-18881.creator: Kasturi Vasudevan
arxiv-2602-18881.description: Abstract This work investigates the bit-error-rate (BER) performance of turbo coded orthogonal frequency division multiplexed - offset quadrature amplitude modulated (OFDM- OQAM) signals transmitted through frequency selective Rayleigh fading channels in the presence of carrier frequency offset (CFO) and additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN).

pmc-11645040.title: Design and Validation of an Obstacle Contact Sensor for Aerial Robots
pmc-11645040.creator: Victor Vigara-Puche, Manuel J. Fernandez-Gonzalez, Matteo Fumagalli
pmc-11645040.description: Obstacle contact detection is not commonly employed in autonomous robots, which mainly depend on avoidance algorithms, limiting their effectiveness in cluttered environments. Current contact-detection techniques suffer from blind spots or discretized detection points, and rigid platforms further limit performance by merely detecting the presence of a collision without providing detailed feedback.

pmc-12583444.title: Computational and pharmacophore-based study of Camellia sinensis phytochemicals targeting BRAF in melanoma
pmc-12583444.creator: Md. Shah Poran Shuvo, S M Riaduzzaman Niaz, Sumaia Jannat, Md. Arju Hossain, Nurullah Mashhur, Nasim Ahmed, Md Sohel, Md Imran Hasan, Siddique Akber Ansari, Mahammad Humayoo, Md Habibur Rahman, Md. Khairul Islam
pmc-12583444.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Melanoma is the deadliest kind and most invasive form of skin cancer caused by exposure to UV light and mutation in BRAF signaling protein. Plant-derived phytochemicals have several anticancer properties and used as therapeutic option since ancient era. The purpose of this research is to look at their potential for BRAF protein inhibition in melanoma through molecular docking, pharmacophore modeling, pharmacokinetics, molecular dynamic stimulation and quantum mechanics studies using the phytochemicals from green tea (Camellia sinensis).

pmc-12739142.creator: João P S Maurício de Carvalho
pmc-12739142.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). We perform a qualitative analysis of a periodically-forced SIR model which incorporates the disease transmission rate by direct contact with the natural viral source, in addition to the classic disease transmission rate between individuals. We direct this work towards two main topics: (i) in the absence of seasonality, the endemic equilibrium point (and unique) undergoes both supercritical and subcritical Hopf bifurcations.

pmc-12884428.title: Modeling chronic periodontitis in rats: Persistent alveolar bone loss mediated by periodontal pathogens
pmc-12884428.creator: Maksym Skrypnyk, Chun Xu, Shlomo Berkovsky, Thilini Jayasinghe, Axel Spahr
pmc-12884428.description: BackgroundAlthough widely used in periodontal research, rodents are naturally resistant to periodontitis. Conventional models, such as ligature‐induced periodontitis, often fail to sustain defects due to spontaneous tissue regeneration after ligature removal. To address this, we refined a rat ligature‐induced model of experimental periodontitis to better mimic the chronic, progressive nature of human periodontitis.

pmc-13071289.title: Association between cardiometabolic index and high-sensitivity C-reactive protein: A cross-sectional study from National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2015 to 2018
pmc-13071289.creator: Yuhao Yan, Yong Tang
pmc-13071289.description: ObjectiveHigh-sensitivity C-reactive protein, a key inflammatory biomarker, can indicate the risk of cardiovascular diseases. The cardiometabolic index has been associated with metabolic and cardiovascular outcomes; however, its direct relationship with high-sensitivity C-reactive protein remains unclear. This study aimed to explore this association and identify influencing factors in adult population.

The primary objective was incidence and severity of POST.

pmc-13427008.title: Clinical Use and Perception About Synthetic Liothyronine for the Treatment of Primary Hypothyroidism Among Healthcare Professionals in India
pmc-13427008.creator: Sameer Aggarwal, Lovely Gupta, Deepak Khandelwal, Sachin Chittawar, Shweta Sharma, Mohan T. Shenoy, Umesh K. Garg, Naima Parveen, Mona Sood
pmc-13427008.description: Introduction:Hypothyroidism is commonly managed with levothyroxine (LT4) monotherapy, the standard treatment for many decades. However, 5%–10% of patients remain symptomatic despite achieving biochemical euthyroidism on LT4 monotherapy. Liothyronine (LT3), a synthetic form of T3, was introduced in India in 2022 but faces limited adoption due to availability, cost, and lack of clear guidelines.

pmc-13593282.title: Memantine-Induced Cholestasis and Acute Hepatitis in an 8-Week-Old Term Infant
pmc-13593282.creator: Briona Thompson, Kadakkal Radhakrishnan
pmc-13593282.description: Cholestasis and hepatitis in infants occur for various reasons and require further evaluation. We present an 8-week-old term male infant with cholestasis secondary to breast milk transference of memantine. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first case associated with cholestasis and acute hepatitis with memantine transference through breast-feeding.
